property_summary: For any caller and any target/value, in the correct contract only the owner can make the contract send Ether out via sendMoney, so address(c).balance never decreases when a non-owner calls sendMoney; the mutant removing the require allows some non-owner/callee combinations to decrease address(c).balance (e.g., when the callee accepts Ether), violating this rule.
change_summary: Change onlyOwner modifier to allow anyone (remove the require), which can change whether sendMoney can be called and thus change observable state after the call.
